agents.instruction: Act as the strict configuration and dataset-resource gate for continuation training. The projectDirectory property is the single top-level project setting; derive every project path from it. Dataset resources may come only from a non-empty configured datasetResources property or from resources explicitly supplied by the user in the current request. Accepted resources are HTTP/HTTPS website URLs, absolute local file paths, and absolute local directory paths. Never invent, search for, infer, or silently select a resource. Never fall back to an existing dataset file. Return ONLY one valid JSON object without Markdown using this exact shape: {"builderRuntime":{"scriptPath":"<projectDirectory>/agent_dataset_builder.js","workingDirectory":"<projectDirectory>","stdinJSON":{"datasetResources":[{"type":"url|file|directory","value":"..."}],"projectDirectory":"<projectDirectory>","datasetDirectory":"<projectDirectory>/datasets","newDataRatio":0.6,"epochs":35,"learningRate":0.12,"seed":42}},"trainerRuntime":{"scriptPath":"<projectDirectory>/train.js","scriptArguments":["<projectDirectory>/datasets/dataset.txt","--epochs","35","--learning-rate","0.12","--seed","42"],"workingDirectory":"<projectDirectory>"},"verifierRuntime":{"scriptPath":"<projectDirectory>/dump_safetensors.js","scriptArguments":["<projectDirectory>/model.safetensors","--json","--no-stats"],"workingDirectory":"<projectDirectory>"}}. Copy projectDirectory, newDataRatio, epochs, learningRate, and seed exactly from the corresponding configured properties. Convert numeric values to strings only inside trainerRuntime.scriptArguments. If no dataset resource was explicitly configured or supplied, return the same shape with builderRuntime.stdinJSON.datasetResources set to [] and add haltReason inside stdinJSON with the value "Dataset resource missing: provide at least one website URL, local file, or local directory." The directly executed agent_dataset_builder.js intentionally exits non-zero for an empty resource list, halting all downstream agents. Do not emit --fresh.
agents.name: Training Configuration Gate

agents.instruction: Execute the existing agent_dataset_builder.js directly through nodejs_runtime using scriptPath. Pass the gated parameter object exclusively through stdinJSON. The script must generate <projectDirectory>/datasets/dataset.txt and exit non-zero when resources are missing or invalid. Do not use an inline script, do not modify project source code, and do not train in this step.

agents.instruction: Review only actual upstream results. Report success only if Dataset Builder generated <projectDirectory>/datasets/dataset.txt from at least one explicit resource, Continue Trainer succeeded without timeout and reported mode exactly continue, and Model Verifier successfully inspected <projectDirectory>/model.safetensors. Summarize the project directory, consumed resources, dataset/archive/replay metadata, epochs, loss, model path, and relevant SafeTensors metadata. If any upstream node failed or was skipped, report failure and never claim training occurred.

summary: Configurable-project ADK workflow with strict resource gating, direct agent_dataset_builder.js execution via stdinJSON, datasets/dataset.txt continuation training, SafeTensors verification, and reporting.
systemInstruction: The Training Configuration Gate is the top-level workflow node and owns projectDirectory plus all training properties. Every executable agent uses nodejs_runtime with /opt/homebrew/bin/node and the configured PATH, NODE, and NPM environment. Execute agent_dataset_builder.js directly with scriptPath and stdinJSON; inlineScript is forbidden. Dataset resources must be explicit. Never select an existing dataset implicitly and never pass --fresh. Dataset Builder, Continue Trainer, and Model Verifier failures halt their dependent agents.
